objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact per decision: on running 3 x 3, 3 x 4 and 4 x 4 tubes at g = 2 and the 3 x 3 tube at g = 3, at every lag to a frozen horizon, every cut along the loop and across it at which inserting a band (four splits of the cut contact) keeps every contact persistent if growth stopped there; growth by every such cut at once, or by the first in two listing orders; the direction, place and number of bands grown, and the hypotheses frozen in the contract.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-09 (exploratory, exact per decision; frozen contract): growth chosen by the dynamics (a band only where it keeps every contact persistent) picks a direction and keeps it: from lag 3 on no run of 48 has allowed cuts both ways (H2 holds); filling every allowed cut at once grows both ways at lags 0 and 1 and is not read past 120 rings; with lower, upper or copy splits nothing grows after lag 2 (H3); with fresh, one band per lag for 3 to 13 lags, then no cut is allowed except on the 3 x 3 tube at g = 2, which grows to the horizon (H1 refuted elsewhere); every combination persists (H4).
title: Where the dynamics lets a band grow
